name: Summer Day
source:
Summer in Oushou, Date Masamune is bored and doesn't want to work with such a warmth. Maybe Kojuro can help him to be more at ease?

[From [url=http://kazuny.deviantart.com/art/Summer-Day-KoMasa-Game-336443475]Deviantart[/url]]
translation:
奥州的夏天，伊达政宗很无聊，不想和这样的温情一起工作。或许小十郎可以让他安心一些？

[来自[url=http://kazuny.deviantart.com/art/Summer-Day-KoMasa-Game-336443475]德维安塔特[/url]]
